name: Login announces the released Heroic and Mythic dungeon events
contract: The client offers Random Classic Dungeon Heroic (1258) and Mythic (2258) only while one of their game events is active (C_LFG.RequiresGameEvent), otherwise it reports the difficulty as not released; each Burning Crusade dungeon group and random queue needs its own event (C_LFG.lua and Enum.lua in the installed client patches). Each login sends one active SMSG_GAME_EVENT_INFO (0x09BD) for every Heroic event (394, 395, 396, 436, 437, 447; Burning Crusade 339 random, 400 Hellfire, 401 Coilfang, 402 Auchindoun, 403 Tempest Keep, 404 Caverns of Time) and every Mythic event (728 to 732, 734; Burning Crusade 365 random, 221 Hellfire, 222 Coilfang, 223 Auchindoun, 224 Tempest Keep, 225 Caverns of Time). This checks the packets the server builds for a socketless session, not the client's rendering of the Dungeon Finder.
